$schema_note: ReqGraph v0.2 role/model configuration. Model ids remain deployment placeholders.

critic.purpose: attack requirements: ambiguity, gaps, contradictions, edge cases

formalizer.purpose: contracts and behavioral examples; candidate specs in legacy mode

planner.purpose: derive authorized tasks from validated contracts/issues

codegen.purpose: generate tests and authorized implementation changes
codegen.profile: coding; constrained by validated contracts/examples and task scope
codegen.hard_rule: out-of-scope findings become Issue; do not modify without authorization

librarian.purpose: graph extraction/update, embeddings, todo compression, provenance

reverse_analyst.purpose: infer ObservedBehavior and candidate behavioral/semantic knowledge from repository evidence
reverse_analyst.hard_rule: never mark inferred intent as validated

impact_analyst.purpose: evaluate semantic impact of changed CodeUnit/ConfigUnit on candidate contracts
impact_analyst.hard_rule: candidate selection starts from deterministic graph/static analysis; analyst does not silently shrink the safety set

issue_triage.purpose: assist Issue classification, evidence gathering and candidate links
issue_triage.hard_rule: classification does not authorize code modification

retrieval.strategy: hybrid vector entry-point + typed traversal + provenance/status filtering + balancing
impact_traversal_rules: changed CodeUnit|ConfigUnit -> DEPENDS_ON and reverse DEPENDS_ON, bounded
do not invalidate merely because nodes share a path/file
